name: Tuna Lasagna with Tomato, Spinach and Ricotta

components.name: Tuna Lasagna

ingredients.name: Canned tuna in water, drained weight

steps: Preheat oven to 190 C. Sauté chopped onion and garlic in oil, then stir in passata and oregano and simmer until thick enough to layer.
Drain tuna well, flake with a fork, and combine with tomato sauce and wilted spinach.
In a separate bowl mix ricotta, eggs and half the parmesan until smooth.
Spread a thin spoonful of tomato sauce in a deep baking dish, then alternate dry lasagna sheets, tuna tomato layer and ricotta mixture.

Finish with mozzarella and remaining parmesan. Cover with foil, bake about 35 minutes, then uncover another 15-20 minutes until bubbling and pasta soft; ensure internal temperature reaches at least 74 C with eggs fully set.
Rest 15-20 minutes before dividing into six portions; cool and refrigerate or freeze promptly.
